description: Coordinate appointments, rides, mobility devices, caregivers, timing.
notes: Coded against the Kit contract with a guarded inline fallback shim (window.Kit || ...); the real shared/kit.js landed mid-build and takes precedence — all 10 verified against the real kit: zero console/page errors, core interactions clicked, 1280x800 shot captured.

notes.note: Wheelchair-capable medical transport is a genuine coordination nightmare, but this is a logistics marketplace wearing a software costume — $4/trip margins against real-world dispatch ops. The free planning tool doesn't create supply; the supply is the business, and it's an operations company, not a SaaS.

notes.change: stat cards (.k-kpis) stacked full-width because shared kit.css has no .k-kpis layout rule; added flex row with wrap so the 4 stats sit side-by-side

notes.note: Optimize route recomputes itinerary; timing-risk panel updates, zero errors.

notes.change: Traffic-conditions slider (0.8x-1.6x) rescales all drive times live, so timing risk reacts to rush hour; persisted. Addresses the 'seeded travel times' limitation.
